security_scope_boundary_clarification.patient_id_consistency_scope: The cross-patient document isolation check verifies data-consistency binding between patient records and uploaded document IDs. It guarantees that a document belonging to Patient A is rejected with HTTP 404 when requested under Patient B's endpoint. CRITICAL CLARIFICATION: This is an internal integrity check, NOT a replacement for enterprise authentication (OAuth2/JWT/mTLS) or role-based access control (RBAC).
security_scope_boundary_clarification.authentication_status: Not Yet Implemented (Synthetic Local Demonstration Mode)
security_scope_boundary_clarification.authorization_status: Not Yet Implemented (No clinician/patient session separation)
security_scope_boundary_clarification.data_environment_restriction: Strictly restricted to synthetic local research demonstration data with zero PHI.

file_processing_hardening.file_size_limit: 15 MB (15,728,640 bytes) strictly enforced with HTTP 400 Bad Request
file_processing_hardening.magic_bytes_inspection: Strict header inspection: PDF (%PDF), PNG (\x89PNG), JPEG (\xff\xd8)
file_processing_hardening.path_traversal_sanitization: re.sub(r'[^a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.]', '_', filename) and sandbox confinement in data/uploads/
file_processing_hardening.malformed_file_handling: Malformed, corrupt, or unreadable files raise controlled HTTP 400 Bad Request errors. Internal file paths and Python tracebacks are strictly suppressed in API error payloads.
